findings.finding: Each public collectAxioms call initializes a fresh local State; separate print calls do not share that local seen map.
Imported declarations already share persistent precomputed axiom summaries, looked up before local memoization.
Lean's module exporter already computes summaries for all exported current-module declarations with one shared collector state.

memoization_feasibility: A cache of complete exact axiom-dependency sets can be shared across declarations in the same checked environment without omitting dependencies. This is a semantic possibility, already reflected by the pinned export implementation, not a claim that it is the observed timeout cause.
requirements_for_any_future_change: Bind cached summaries to the checked environment and declaration identities.
Reuse complete dependency sets, including all dependencies already traversed by the standard collector.
Do not treat an in-progress cycle sentinel as a completed summary.
Retain the exact named output profiles, allowed-axiom validation and all kernel checks.
